For Respondent(s) : Mr.M.S.Panwar, P.P.
_____________________________________________________
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sandeep Mehta
Judgment / Order 05/02/2018
Since the Appellate Tribunal has been constituted under The Food Safety and Standards Act, the instant misc. petition is no longer maintainable and is disposed of as such.

The interim protection provided to the petitioners vide order dated 24.4.2015 shall continue for the next 30 days and, the petitioners may, if they so desire, prefer an appeal before the learned Appellate Tribunal against the impugned order in this period.
In the event of the appeal being preferred within the next 30 days, the same shall be treated to be within limitation and shall be considered on merits.
With these directions, the misc. petition is disposed of.
(2 of 2) [CRLMP-1023/2015] The interim protection granted to the petitioners by this Court on 24.4.2015 shall continue for 30 days.

(SANDEEP MEHTA), J.
